verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs claim tracing through "100+ library/framework integrations", OpenTelemetry, and gateways such as LiteLLM, and one community user confirms running it through LiteLLM, so pre-built integrations exist. However, none of the named frameworks (LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, the Vercel AI SDK) is specifically documented in the pack, so complete coverage of the story is unproven. One user's report that an AI-recommended Claude instrumentation approach failed concerns documentation quality, not these named integrations. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the LangChain, OpenAI SDK and Vercel AI SDK integrations, setup depth for them, and independent hands-on corroboration of those specific integrations

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: Capture traces via our native SDKs for Python/JS, 100+ library/framework integrations, OpenTelemetry, or via an LLM Gateway such as LiteLLM
most integrations capture usage and cost automatically
